subject: TARGET CLAIM: Fold7 presentation-time visual phase control and frame pacing
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-research-rd-4-visual-phase-20261002T000801Z. WORKSTREAM_STATE=CLAIMED. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. INVESTIGATION_BOUNDARY=visual phase/timing only: quantify last-sample + first-order follower phase error, determine whether existing FrameTimeline timing can safely drive bounded presentation-time angle prediction, define confidence/reversal/staleness fallback rules, and prototype/test an Android-free predictor/control contract. EXPLICIT NON-GOALS=no changes to Fold7 continuity state transitions, cover lease/CAS authority, process recovery, service-stable presentation identity, terminal native handoff, content freshness, precise-angle source authority, panel power/routing, mirror geometry, or production files. KNOWN_OVERLAP=historic transition-observability supplies measurement primitives only and explicitly left TiltFollower/PanelEngine behavior unchanged; this work consumes those measurements but does not reopen its correlation work. HYPOTHESIS=current Samsung continuous path still drives TiltFollower from the most recently delivered angle with a 28 ms time constant, so visual geometry can lag physical geometry under sustained motion; presentation-time prediction may reduce modeled phase error if bounded and disabled on stale/reversal/low-confidence input. Device validation is required before any production tuning. No production writes.
